dateline: Seoul / Global — Rest day post-Mexico City; Billboard confirms SWIM 8th Hot 100 week & ARIRANG 8th Billboard 200 Top-5 week; HYBE launches ABD label
heroHeadline: Day 4,715: SWIM & ARIRANG Set All-Time K-pop Billboard Records; HYBE Launches New Label ABD
heroSubtitle: May 11, 2026 is Day 4,715 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Billboard's May 16-dated charts (released May 11) confirm that 'SWIM' completes its eighth consecutive week on the Billboard Hot 100 — an all-time record for K-pop — while ARIRANG extends its historic run to eight consecutive weeks in the Billboard 200 Top 5, the longest any K-pop album has ever maintained a Top-5 presence in chart history. Thirteen ARIRANG tracks chart concurrently on the Billboard Global 200. BTS is on a rest and travel day following the completion of their sold-out three-night Mexico City run at Estadio GNP Seguros (May 7, 9, 10 — 136,000+ total fans), the largest K-pop stadium event in Latin American history. The Las Vegas leg of the ARIRANG World Tour launches May 23 at Allegiant Stadium, with six nights scheduled through May 28. Separately, HYBE announces the launch of a new label, ABD (A Bold Dream), led by Noh Ji-won with Han Sung-soo overseeing creative production — a new girl group subsidiary targeting H2 2026. HYBE's Q1 2026 revenue reached nearly $480M, driven largely by the ARIRANG World Tour.
